steps.label: PROBE-helper-def
steps.expr: (() => { window.__probe = () => { const f = document.querySelector('form'); const card = f ? f.closest('.surface') : null; const cf = document.querySelector('.cf-turnstile'); const sub = document.querySelector('button[type=submit]'); const r = sub ? sub.getBoundingClientRect() : null; return { pageH: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, cardH: card ? card.offsetHeight : null, turnstileH: cf ? cf.offsetHeight : null, cardTitle: card ? (card.querySelector('h1')||{}).innerText : null, cardDesc: card ? (card.querySelector('h1')?.parentElement?.querySelector('p')?.innerText || null) : null, fields: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=hidden])')).map(i=>i.id), tabsVisible: !!document.querySelector('.grid.grid-cols-2'), submitTop: r?Math.round(r.top):null, submitVisibleNoScroll: r ? (r.top>=0 && r.bottom<=window.innerHeight) : null, active: document.activeElement.id || document.activeElement.tagName }; }; return window.__probe(); })()

steps.label: E-focus-visible-check
steps.expr: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return { id: a.id, top: Math.round(r.top), bottom: Math.round(r.bottom), innerHeight: window.innerHeight, fullyInViewport: r.top>=0 && r.bottom<=window.innerHeight, scrollY: Math.round(window.scrollY) }; })()

steps.label: G-drift-forensics-10s
steps.expr: (async () => { const samples = []; for (let i=0;i<10;i++){ const cf=document.querySelector('.cf-turnstile'); samples.push({ t:i*1000, pageH: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, turnstileH: cf?cf.offsetHeight:null, strengthH: (document.querySelector('.min-h-\\[30px\\]')||{}).offsetHeight ?? null }); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000)); } return samples; })()

steps.label: H-forgot-link-present
steps.expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>/Forgot password/i.test(x.textContent)); if(!b) return {found:false}; const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); return { found:true, text:b.textContent.trim(), top:Math.round(r.top), visible: r.top>=0 && r.bottom<=window.innerHeight }; })()

steps.label: I-click-forgot-via-js
steps.expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>/Forgot password/i.test(x.textContent)); b.click(); return { clicked:true, url: location.search }; })()
